questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to apply 3-valued Kleene semantics to rule-based constraints and design simple propagation.

## Key Concepts

- 3-valued logic: T > U > F, ¬T=F, ¬F=T, ¬U=U
- Implication as ¬p ∨ q, with Kleene order
- Forward-propagation: iteratively apply constraints until a fixed point

## Code Example

```javascript
function not(v){return v==='T'?'F':v==='F'?'T':'U';}
function imp(p,q){const np=not(p); return (np==='T' || q==='T')?'T':(np==='U'||q==='U')?'U':'F';}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you extend to detect unsatisfiable sets?
- How would you prove minimality of a satisfying assignment?

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This tests practical thinking on 3-valued logic in a real system (rule engines) and backtracking strategies beyond standard boolean logic.

## Key Concepts
- Kleene 3-valued semantics for ∨, ∧, ¬, and →
- Backtracking propagation to prune invalid states
- Handling Unknowns to avoid premature F outcomes

## Code Example
```javascript
function kleeneNot(x){ return x==='T'?'F':x==='F'?'T':'U'; }
function kleeneOr(a,b){ if(a==='T'||b==='T') return 'T'; if(a==='U'||b==='U') return 'U'; return 'F'; }
function kleeneImp(p,q){ return kleeneOr(kleeneNot(p), q); }
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you scale this to five variables with cycles?
- Which heuristics pick U values to maximize propagation before backtracking?

## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design a small, time-expanded 3-valued CSP and reason about propagation with Unknowns.

## Key Concepts
- 3-valued Kleene logic
- Constraint propagation and backtracking
- Time-indexed constraints and implication semantics

## Code Example
```javascript
// quick sketch: propagate step
function kleeneImpl(a,b){ // a→b in Kleene: ¬a ∨ b
  if (a==='F') return 'T';
  if (a==='T') return b;
  return (b==='T' ? 'T' : (b==='F' ? 'F' : 'U'));
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you scale to N time steps?
- How would you encode this as a SAT problem for larger instances?
